mapper.sql: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_catalogo as catalog ,crmp_cuenta as account ,(select ccue_nombre from cuenta_ccuep where ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta) as accountName ,(select ccue_codigo from cuenta_ccuep where ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta) as accountCode ,nrmp_nivel as level ,drmp_fechainicio as startDate ,drmp_fechafin as endDate ,crmp_periodo as period ,nrmp_ano as year ,nrmp_mes as month ,nrmp_dia as day ,nrmp_hora as hour ,nrmp_minuto as minute ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,crmp_tipo as type ,drmp_creacionfecha as createdAt ,crmp_creacionusuario as createdUser ,crmp_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,drmp_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,crmp_estado as state from account.mapa_resultados_rmp a
mapper.select: update account.mapa_resultados_rmp set drmp_modificacionfecha = now(), crmp_catalogo = #{catalog}, crmp_cuenta = #{account}, nrmp_nivel = #{level}, drmp_fechainicio = #{startDate}, drmp_fechafin = #{endDate}, crmp_periodo = #{period}, nrmp_ano = #{year}, nrmp_mes = #{month}, nrmp_dia = #{day}, nrmp_hora = #{hour}, nrmp_minuto = #{minute}, nrmp_cantidad = #{quantity}, nrmp_promedio = #{average}, mrmp_saldoanterior = #{lastBalance}, mrmp_saldosiguiente = #{nextBalance}, mrmp_positivo = #{positive}, mrmp_negativo = #{negative}, mrmp_valor = #{value}, crmp_tipo = #{type}, crmp_estado =#{state}
